label: Stored correction transport
title: Stored instructions execute correction transport, but a zero cap does not close it
kind: Exact interior law and finite-cap counterexample
summary: Program(r,60) physically executes F(row) xor the next correction row. A finite prepared stack has an exact protected time triangle, but a frozen zero cap can corrupt the bottom; local cap factorization is the next test.
takeaway: Boundary stability and correction sufficiency are different conditions. The physical interior law works; an indefinitely valid finite cap remains to be constructed.
